title: YouTube Channel Videos - Uploads, Views & Duration
description: Minimal input: {"channels": ["@3blue1brown"], "maxResultsPerSource": 3}. Cost is $0.005 per parsed page plus $0.001 per delivered video. Empty monitoring/filter results still incur page fees. Set maxTotalChargeUsd in Apify run options for a monetary cap.

channels.title: YouTube channels
channels.description: Public channel handles, UC IDs or HTTPS /@handle and /channel/UC… URLs, for example ["@3blue1brown"]. Up to 50 channels. Regular Videos tab only; Shorts/live tabs, video URLs and playlists are not accepted. Each parsed page costs $0.005 plus $0.001 per delivered video.

maxResultsPerSource.title: Maximum delivered rows per source
maxResultsPerSource.description: Maximum rows delivered per query/channel after filters and monitoring, for example 50. A source can return fewer. Duplicates are removed across this run.

minViews.title: Minimum views
minViews.description: Keep videos at or above this displayed view count, for example 100000. Zero disables it. YouTube rounds counts such as 2.6M; views_approximate marks these. Missing counts do not pass an active bound.

minDurationSeconds.title: Minimum video duration
minDurationSeconds.description: Minimum video length in seconds, for example 300 for five minutes. Zero disables the bound. Missing/live durations do not pass an active bound.

maxDurationSeconds.title: Maximum video duration
maxDurationSeconds.description: Maximum video length in seconds, for example 1200 for twenty minutes. Zero disables the bound. Filtering adds no fee; parsed pages still cost $0.005.

onlyNew.title: Only new videos
onlyNew.description: true emits only video IDs not previously delivered under monitorKey. First run establishes the baseline by delivering matching videos. Later checks still pay parsed-page fees, even with no new uploads. Use a saved task and an Apify schedule.

titleContains.title: Title includes any
titleContains.description: Keep titles containing at least one phrase, case-insensitive; for example ["wireless"] or ["math"]. Empty means any title. Applied before row billing; successful page checks are still billed.

titleExcludes.title: Title excludes any
titleExcludes.description: Drop titles containing any phrase, case-insensitive; for example ["case"] or ["trailer"]. Empty disables exclusions. Dropped rows are not billed; parsed pages are.

monitorKey.title: Monitor name
monitorKey.description: Name for persistent delivered-row history, for example "daily-competitors". Use 1–60 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Reuse with the same target list and filters; change it for a new baseline. Keeps the latest 50,000 delivered IDs.

excludeIds.title: Previously collected IDs
excludeIds.description: Skip exact output id values, for example ["a-previous-id"]. Up to 10,000. An optional alternative to persistent monitoring; excluded rows are not billed but parsed pages are.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Maximum pages per source
maxPagesPerSource.description: Safety cap on successful page reads per query/channel, for example 5. Maximum 50. Every parsed page costs $0.005, including filtered/unchanged pages. The result limit can stop sooner. Source pagination does not guarantee complete coverage.
